notes.title: Definitive Edition
notes.notes:
CHANGELOG 12/1/2022
- Added an "All Graphics Quality" setting in the options menu (Default value of 1 which is Medium)
- Removed sparks and smoke from Torches for improved FPS.
- Fixed Result Screen UI alignment and added "Time" result for speedrunners. (Timer stops on escape, before cinematic)
- Adjusted Sunlight color and direction for final cinematic.
